name: Calendar Panel
description:
Calendar Panel turns the XENEON Edge into a glanceable day timeline. Add up to three ICS calendar feeds and see what is next, what is happening now, and how packed the rest of the day really is.

The wide layout positions events by real start time and duration, with a live now marker and a separate all-day rail. Tap any event for full details including location. Tap the next-event card to switch between today and the next three days.

Recurring events, recurrence exceptions, all-day events, timezone-aware times, overlapping meetings, stale data, empty days, and feed failures are handled deliberately.

No OAuth, account login, Stream Deck plugin, or separate paid companion is required. Calendar Panel first reads configured ICS feeds directly. If a calendar provider blocks direct XENEON browser access, it automatically falls back to Packrat's stateless calendar relay. The relay does not cache or application-log calendar URLs or calendar bodies.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for CORSAIR XENEON Edge.
release_notes:
• Calendar Panel now works independently with no Calendar Sync Pro or Stream Deck companion required
• Added an automatic fallback for calendar providers that block direct XENEON browser access
• Removed the COMPANION NEEDED state and cross-product purchase prompt
• Improved feed error handling while keeping secret calendar URLs out of local storage
